# Harrison

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a short, fat, bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. His face is surrounded by a little fringe of hair around his ears.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021)_

## Personality

Mr. Harrison is an outspoken, cranky, and eccentric man who prides himself on telling the plain truth regardless of others' feelings. Despite his crusty, irritable exterior and hasty temper, he possesses a soft heart, a sense of humor, and a capacity for warmth once understood. He is initially set in his ways and hates being fussed over, though he secretly appreciates comfort, company, and neighborly goodwill.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009)_

## Traits

- outspoken  <sub>[v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>
- irritable and quick-tempered  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>

## Abilities

- brewing tea  <sub>[v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)</sub>
- farming and crop management  <sub>[v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c6 P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

- to live unbothered by domestic fuss while maintaining a quiet, comfortable home  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## History

Mr. J. A. Harrison originally lived in Scottsford, New Brunswick. After his sister passed away, he married Emily Scott, but their marriage suffered due to clash of habits—especially her obsession with extreme tidiness and her dislike of his profane parrot, Ginger. Following a severe quarrel over the parrot during a visit from local ministers, Emily left him, and Mr. Harrison subsequently relocated to Avonlea, buying Robert Bell's farm and living as an eccentric, self-proclaimed bachelor. He first met Anne Shirley when her Jersey cow repeatedly broke into his oatfield, leading to an angry confrontation. Shortly afterward, Anne accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's Jersey cow instead of her own, but when she went to confess and make amends, he forgave her good-naturedly and accepted her cow in exchange, sparking a warm neighborly friendship between them. Mr. Harrison supported Anne's Village Improvement Society projects, though he initially refused to contribute financially.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 c3 P40](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0040), [v2 c3 P48](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0048), [v2 c9 P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 c24 P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 c24 P44](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0044), [v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_

## Background by volume

- lived in Scottsford, New Brunswick, before moving to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- married Emily Scott three years before moving to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- separated from his wife over domestic friction and her hatred of his parrot Ginger  <sub>[v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- bought Robert Bell's farm in Avonlea in early April  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> I can't help speaking out just what I think and folks must take me as they find me.  <sub>[v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>

> I'm a crusty, lonesome, crabbed old chap, but there's something about that little girl makes me feel young again . . . and it's such a pleasant sensation I'd like to have it repeated once in a while.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>
